lines.en: I go along in little hops.
My long ears swing on both sides.
I step on leaves and they sound.

lines.zh: 我在白桦林里转来转去
lines.en: I wander through the birches.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴很短，几乎看不见
lines.en: My tail is short, barely visible.
Every two steps I lift my head.
I stop and lift a foot.
My Petit Twister carries leaves.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵一只立着，一只歪着
lines.en: One ear up, one ear flopped.

lines.zh: 我绕过一根倒下的桦木
lines.en: I go around a fallen birch.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵被树枝刮了一下
lines.en: A twig grazes my ear.

lines.zh: 我跳到一块石头上看前面
lines.en: I hop onto a stone to look ahead.

lines.zh: 白桦皮的味道让我发呆。
lines.en: The smell of birch bark makes me stare.
My long ears hang to my shoulders.
Birch bark rustles in the wind.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把一只耳朵转过去
lines.en: I turn one ear slowly.

lines.zh: 鼻子动了两下，是你的味道。
lines.en: Two sniffs; that is your scent.
I look up at a bird in the tree.

lines.zh: 我把两只前爪放在一起
lines.en: I put my forepaws together.

lines.zh: 白桦林里，兔子皮是我掉的。
lines.en: In the birches, this rabbit pelt is my drop.
Ears drooping, I curl into a ball.
A leaf lands on my head.

lines.zh: 一只耳朵转过去听虫声。
lines.en: One ear swivels toward the insects.
Insects keep calling in the birches.

lines.zh: 我把长耳朵铺在落叶上。
lines.en: I spread my long ears on the fallen leaves.
I wipe my face with a forepaw.
I raise my ears.
I look up, long ears drooping to my shoulders.
I cock my head at you.
I hop one small step forward.

lines.zh: 我不确定你是不是朋友
lines.en: I am not sure whether you are a friend.

lines.zh: 我把耳朵立起来，你比我高很多。
lines.en: I raise my ears; you are much taller.

lines.zh: 我提起一只前爪停在胸前
lines.en: I lift a forepaw and hold it at my chest.

lines.zh: 我从树后探出半个身子
lines.en: I show half of myself from behind the tree.

lines.zh: 我看了看你，又看了看旁边
lines.en: I look at you, then aside.
I shift back a step at a time.

lines.zh: 你说话的声音不太吓人
lines.en: Your voice is not very frightening.
I slowly flatten my ears.
I am wondering whether you are edible.
I hop one more small step.

lines.zh: 你的手放在我头顶的高度
lines.en: Your hands are at the height of my head.

lines.zh: 我忽然转身，耳朵甩起来
lines.en: I turn suddenly, ears swinging.
I cry out and curl up.
My ears press to my back.

lines.zh: 我耳朵一甩，退进落叶里。
lines.en: I flick my ears and retreat into the leaves.
I sit on the ground, breathing hard.
I shrink to the tree roots.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵一只立不起来了
lines.en: One ear will not stand up.

lines.zh: 我这对长耳朵，垂得很低。
lines.en: These long ears droop low.
I press myself very low.
My breathing is small and quick.
I hug my belly.
There's sweetness between your fingers.
I hop one step forward.
I will not snatch; I only want to sniff.
I sniff; it is something good.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵都朝你那边了
lines.en: Both my ears point at you.
Could you hold it lower?
I bring my nose closer.
This smells sweet.
I nibble a corner with my front teeth.
A few crumbs still cling to my mouth.
The tips of my ears tremble.
I hold it so you cannot take it back.
I bounce off when I hit you.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵被撞得甩了一下
lines.en: My ears swing from the knock.
I sit down, startled.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的影子，我跳开
lines.en: You step on my shadow and I hop away.
I catch at your trouser leg.
The knock sits me down.
I hop clear, then come near again.
Your shoe is much bigger than me.
My ear brushes your hand.
I slip past your leg.
She has long ears too.
Our ears touch once.
She hops a little farther than me.
We sit under the tree together.
She smooths my ear.
She touches her ear to mine.
We hop along together.
She sits beside me, very quiet.

lines.zh: 她替我把背上的叶子弄掉
lines.en: She picks a leaf off my back.

lines.zh: 我们一起把耳朵贴在风里
lines.en: We both turn our ears to the wind.

lines.zh: 我垂下来的长耳，扫过你的靴子。
lines.en: My long drooping ears brush your boots.

lines.zh: 我两只前爪抱住，走不动。
lines.en: I hug it with both forepaws and can't walk.
I hold it in both forepaws.
I hop twice and it falls.
This time I catch it with my ear.
I crouch and use both forepaws.

lines.zh: 我把它抱在怀里，长耳朵垂下来。
lines.en: I hug it to my chest, long ears drooping.
It falls and I jump once.
I hide it under the roots.
I look back once.
I stop, both ears up.

lines.zh: 我往白桦树后挪了半格。
lines.en: I edge half a block behind the birch.
I lower my body a little.
I freeze, ears forward.
My body presses to the ground.

lines.zh: 我的长耳向后贴住了背。
lines.en: My long ears flatten against my back.
I duck my head a little.
I look for a gap behind the trees.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，耳朵还在抖。
lines.en: I curl up, ears still trembling.
I do not like being stared at.
I begin to edge sideways.
There is shade behind your tree.

lines.zh: 我躲在树后面，只露耳朵
lines.en: I hide behind the tree, only my ears showing.
You come near and I hop back.

lines.zh: 我的目光落在你的手上
lines.en: My gaze rests on your hands.
I hide behind another tree.
I show only half an ear.
You take a step; I hop two.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛一直瞟你的脚
lines.en: My eyes keep flicking to your feet.
I am ready to run into the wood.
I have my way out memorized.
You stop, and I stop too.
The birch trunks screen me.
I do not know what you intend.
I pounce on your calf.
My forepaws swat once.

lines.zh: 我的爪子只刮破了裤脚。
lines.en: My claws only tear your trouser cuff.
I strike and hop away.

lines.zh: 我拍了一下，立刻往后跳。
lines.en: I swat once, then spring back.
My forepaws scratch once.
I bite your sleeve.
I strike and hop back.
My head butts your knee.
My claws slip on your shoe.
I dare strike only once before retreating.

lines.zh: 我用力的时候耳朵往后
lines.en: My ears go back when I strain.
There is a rustle in the birches first.
I hop out from behind the tree.
My ears show first.

lines.zh: 我站在落叶上，看着四周
lines.en: I stand on the leaves, looking around.
I hop twice and stop.

lines.zh: 落叶翻了一下，我钻出来。
lines.en: The dead leaves flip, and I wriggle out.
One ear shows first.

lines.zh: 我从落叶堆里钻出来，长耳朵摆。
lines.en: I push out of the leaf pile, long ears swinging.
I shake the leaf bits off.
I straighten and look around.
The birch shadow falls on me.
I lift my head; wind moves my ears.

lines.zh: 火一靠近，我就跳得很远
lines.en: Fire comes near and I jump far.

lines.zh: 我从石头上掉下来，滚了半圈
lines.en: I fall off the stone and roll half over.

lines.zh: 水没到我的下巴，我扑腾
lines.en: Water reaches my chin and I flounder.
The blast blows me to the tree roots.
The arrow's wind steals a tuft of fur.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我一时动不了
lines.en: That force holds me still.
I am too hungry to hop.

lines.zh: 雷声一响，我钻进落叶里
lines.en: At the thunder I dive into the leaves.

lines.zh: 底下没有地，我一直往下
lines.en: No ground below; I keep falling.
